features.text: Strategic compression design promotes circulation and reduces joint discomfort
Therapeutic warming properties help soothe stiff and aching muscles
Optional patella padding available for enhanced knee cap protection
Breathable materials ensure comfort during extended wear
Versatile support system adapts to various activity levels and conditions

measurement: For optimal stabilization and comfort, measure the circumference of your knee at the center of the patella. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
